text: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield reaches 5.3338%, its highest since 2002, while the 30-year reaches 5.6702%. Sovereign yields also reach multiyear or multidecade highs across Japan, Germany, France, Italy and the U.K.

meta.note: The synchronized yield configuration spans distinct sovereign markets with differing monetary and fiscal structures.

text: GM's Q3 U.S. sales fall 5.5% as several EV models record steep declines. Toyota sales rise 0.6%, with electrified vehicles comprising 57% of volume and rising 28.5%. Honda sales rise 9.3% alongside record hybrid volume.

meta.note: Electrified classifications differ across automakers, with Toyota's category including hybrids and EVs.

text: Nike reports a 4% revenue decline to $11.21 billion, including a 26% decline in Greater China. Its Pace restructuring reduces roles, consolidates operations into three geographic regions and targets $2.5 billion in savings through fiscal 2031.

meta.note: The number and distribution of roles affected by the announced workforce reductions remain unspecified.
